High-level: Orchid builds a SaaS KB/RAG layer for mid-market B2B SaaS vendors (support portals, in-app help). Looking for hosted API to avoid ops overhead. Primary interest: embeddings + two-stage reranking (semantic fetch -> lightweight neural reranker).

- Wants: predictable per-query cost at 500-2k QPS (peak bursts), p95 < 60ms for semantic fetch, p99 < 120ms for reranked queries.

Technical shorthand from SE call (Daniel):
- Indexing: ~2M canonical docs -> ~5M embedded chunks (avg chunk 1.5KB). Update cadence: near-realtime (hourly diffs).
- Embedding vector dim: 1536 (current), open to quantized model variants.
- Reranker: lightweight cross-encoder applied to top-50 candidates; this is the cost hot-path. Looking for fallback policies to cheaper reranker or lexical-first for certain queries.
- Throughput pattern: steady 700 QPS, peaks 2k QPS (short windows). Need autoscaling, warm cache behavior.
- Primary constraints: cost per query, cold-start latency, EU-residency for ~20% of customers.
